lines.zh: 壳沿擦过石砖，我挪向下一个角落。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the bricks as I shift to the next corner.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，装作一只普通的箱子。
lines.en: I hug the wall, pretending to be an ordinary box.

lines.zh: 紫壳一开一合，我在找埋伏的位置。
lines.en: My purple shell opens and shuts while I hunt for a hiding spot.

lines.zh: 脚不着地，我顺着天花板滑过去。
lines.en: I never touch the floor; I slide along the ceiling.

lines.zh: 每一次挪动，都留下一道浅浅的紫痕。
lines.en: Each move I make leaves a faint purple trail.

lines.zh: 我绕开亮处，阴影里更好藏身。
lines.en: I skirt the lit patches; shadows hide me better.

lines.zh: 箱子堆里多了一个，没人会数。
lines.en: One more box in the pile; nobody counts them.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，壳的缝隙只留一线。
lines.en: I creep closer with my shell barely open a crack.

lines.zh: 地板太吵，我干脆浮起来走。
lines.en: The floor is noisy, so I simply float across it.

lines.zh: 挪到宝箱旁边，我停下，学它的样子。
lines.en: Beside the chest I stop and copy its shape.

lines.zh: 我合上壳，等谁先伸手。
lines.en: I close my shell and wait for someone to reach first.

lines.zh: 静止时，我和一只木箱没有分别。
lines.en: Standing still, I am no different from a wooden crate.

lines.zh: 壳里闷得很，可我不敢开太久。
lines.en: It is stuffy inside, but I dare not open for long.

lines.zh: 我数着头顶飘过的紫色粒子。
lines.en: I count the purple motes drifting overhead.

lines.zh: 有人从我身边走过，没有多看一眼。
lines.en: Someone walks past me without a second glance.

lines.zh: 我在壳内把收藏的壳片排好。
lines.en: Inside my shell I arrange my hoarded shell shards.

lines.zh: 呼吸放轻，连缝隙都不漏风。
lines.en: I breathe softly, letting no wind through the seam.

lines.zh: 这具壳比同族的大一圈，也更沉。
lines.en: This shell is a size larger than my kin's, and heavier.

lines.zh: 我记得每一只被我骗过的眼睛。
lines.en: I remember every pair of eyes I have fooled.

lines.zh: 安静久了，我差点真把自己当箱子。
lines.en: Quiet this long, I almost believe I am a box.

lines.zh: 末地的风没有味道，只有灰。
lines.en: The End's wind tastes of nothing but dust.

lines.zh: 我在等一个把背对着我的人。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone to turn their back.

lines.zh: 壳口的锯齿磨得发亮，我挺满意。
lines.en: The serrated rim of my shell is polished bright; I approve.

lines.zh: 别敲我，敲了也不会回话。
lines.en: Do not knock on me; knocking earns no reply.

lines.zh: 我把缝隙压得更窄，只留一线。
lines.en: I press the gap narrower, leaving one line.

lines.zh: 箱盖内侧，我磨出一圈浅槽。
lines.en: On the inside of my lid, I ground a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 你盯着我看太久，我装不下去了。
lines.en: You have stared too long; I can't keep pretending.

lines.zh: 你的手离箱子只有半格，我看见了。
lines.en: Your hand is half a block from the chest. I saw.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，壳缝里透出一点紫光。
lines.en: I lift my gaze; purple light leaks through my seam.

lines.zh: 你在找我？我就在你脚边这只箱子里。
lines.en: Looking for me? I am the crate at your feet.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲很亮，晃得我壳疼。
lines.en: Your armor is so bright it stings my shell.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，也记住你的背影。
lines.en: I have your face now, and your back as well.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，眨眼我就换个位置。
lines.en: Don't blink; blink and I move somewhere else.

lines.zh: 你手里的钥匙，开不了我这只箱。
lines.en: The key in your hand won't open this box.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪壳，像箱盖被风吹动。
lines.en: I tilt my shell as if wind nudged a lid.

lines.zh: 你这么近，我闻得到铁和汗。
lines.en: This close, I smell iron and sweat on you.

lines.zh: 你的同伴在远处，喊你也来不及。
lines.en: Your companion is far off; a shout won't reach in time.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看守盯着一件货物。
lines.en: I watch you the way a guard watches cargo.

lines.zh: 壳上多了一道白痕，我记住了你。
lines.en: A white scar on my shell; I will remember you.

lines.zh: 你会为这一下付出壳片的代价。
lines.en: That strike will cost you shell shards.

lines.zh: 疼是小事，壳裂了才麻烦。
lines.en: The pain is minor; a cracked shell is not.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，只把锯齿露在外面。
lines.en: I pull in, leaving only the serrated rim out.

lines.zh: 你竟然够得到这个高度。
lines.en: You actually reached this height.

lines.zh: 我的壳比你想象的要厚。
lines.en: My shell is thicker than you assumed.

lines.zh: 这一下让我换了个角度看你。
lines.en: That hit made me see you from a new angle.

lines.zh: 我退半格，不是怕，是在量距离。
lines.en: I retreat half a block: measuring, not fleeing.

lines.zh: 紫气从我裂口漏出来，很烫。
lines.en: Purple mist leaks from my crack, and it burns.

lines.zh: 你打偏了，这声闷响是壳在笑。
lines.en: You missed the seam; that dull sound is my shell laughing.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，我举着壳沿。
lines.en: You raise food; I raise the rim of my shell.

lines.zh: 我不吃你手里的东西，我吃耐心。
lines.en: I don't eat what you hold; I feed on patience.

lines.zh: 把诱饵收起来，我认得那种手法。
lines.en: Put the bait away; I know that trick.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃那串东西，我连壳都没开。
lines.en: You jingle that bundle; my shell stays shut.

lines.zh: 想引我出壳？先把手伸近点。
lines.en: Want me out of my shell? Bring that hand closer.

lines.zh: 我不追食物，我只等送上门的人。
lines.en: I chase no food; I wait for what walks to me.

lines.zh: 那点香气穿不透我的壳。
lines.en: That faint scent cannot get through my shell.

lines.zh: 你越急着喂，我越确定有诈。
lines.en: The more eager you feed, the more certain I am of a trap.

lines.zh: 我不是幼体，不会被一把草骗走。
lines.en: I am no hatchling to be led off by a handful of greens.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，留着喂你自己的伤。
lines.en: Keep what you hold for your own wounds.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的壳，像撞上一堵紫墙。
lines.en: You hit my shell like a purple wall.

lines.zh: 别推，我这只箱子里装着牙。
lines.en: Don't shove; this box has teeth inside.

lines.zh: 我顶回去一点，让你知道分量。
lines.en: I push back a little so you feel my weight.

lines.zh: 壳沿划破你的袖子，算个提醒。
lines.en: My rim snags your sleeve as a small reminder.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我就当没发生。
lines.en: Step back half a pace and I'll forget it happened.

lines.zh: 想翻过我？先看看四周有没有落脚处。
lines.en: Want over me? Find somewhere to land first.

lines.zh: 我被撞得晃了晃，紫光散了一地。
lines.en: The bump rocks me; purple light spills around.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在壳上，声音很闷。
lines.en: Your shoulder hits my shell with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪半格，把路让出来一点。
lines.en: I shift half a block aside, yielding a little road.

lines.zh: 撞一次是意外，撞两次是找死。
lines.en: One bump is accident; the second is a death wish.

lines.zh: 同类之间只争地盘，不结伴。
lines.en: My kind fight over ground; we do not pair off.

lines.zh: 这身壳生来就是独住的。
lines.en: This shell was made for living alone.

lines.zh: 没有谁会把壳借给另一只潜影贝。
lines.en: No shulker lends its shell to another.

lines.zh: 我不筑巢，我只占一只箱子。
lines.en: I build no nest; I claim one box.

lines.zh: 想要同伴？先赢过我的壳再说。
lines.en: Want company? Get past my shell first.

lines.zh: 繁殖是软弱者的事，我只扩大领地。
lines.en: Breeding is for the soft; I only widen my ground.

lines.zh: 我听过同类相唤的声音，从不应答。
lines.en: I have heard my kind call; I never answer.

lines.zh: 壳对壳只会撞出裂缝。
lines.en: Shell against shell only makes cracks.

lines.zh: 孤身一只，反倒没人分我的猎物。
lines.en: Alone, no one shares my kill.

lines.zh: 我的后代就是掉落的那几片壳。
lines.en: My legacy is the shell plates I leave behind.

lines.zh: 地上那枚壳片，本来就是我的。
lines.en: That shell shard on the ground was always mine.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我把东西吸进壳里。
lines.en: I don't pick things up; I draw them into my shell.

lines.zh: 那件掉落的护甲太亮，我不需要。
lines.en: That dropped armor is too bright; I have no use.

lines.zh: 有人掉了面包，我没有手去接。
lines.en: Someone dropped bread; I have no hands for it.

lines.zh: 我挪过去，把战利品压在壳底。
lines.en: I slide over and press the spoils under my shell.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的都会归我，慢慢来。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground comes to me, in time.

lines.zh: 你丢下的箭，我一根根收进缝里。
lines.en: The arrows you drop, I tuck one by one into my seam.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，我的壳贴地就行。
lines.en: I never bend; my shell simply meets the floor.

lines.zh: 那堆碎骨对我没用，留给蠕虫吧。
lines.en: That bone pile is useless to me; leave it to the worms.

lines.zh: 东西掉在壳边，就再没被捡回去过。
lines.en: Nothing dropped by my shell has ever been picked back up.

lines.zh: 你踏进这块地面，就算入侵了。
lines.en: You stepped onto this ground; that counts as trespass.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步，壳口已经对准。
lines.en: I hear your steps; my opening is already aimed.

lines.zh: 距离够近了，我不必再装箱子。
lines.en: Close enough; no more pretending to be a crate.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我壳上，我就认准你。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my shell; I fix on you.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，别指望躲在柱子后面。
lines.en: I have you; don't think a pillar will hide you.

lines.zh: 你比铁傀儡好对付，也更吵。
lines.en: Easier than an iron golem, and far noisier.

lines.zh: 那只雪傀儡先放一边，你更近。
lines.en: The snow golem can wait; you are nearer.

lines.zh: 壳缝张开一线，紫气顺着地面爬向你。
lines.en: My seam parts; purple mist crawls toward your feet.

lines.zh: 你身上有末地的味道，我更想咬。
lines.en: You carry the End's scent; that makes me keener.

lines.zh: 我挑了最靠前的那一个，就是你。
lines.en: I pick the one out front: you.

lines.zh: 你回头看了，那就说明你知道了。
lines.en: You looked back, so now you know.

lines.zh: 我慢慢升起，让你看清我的高度。
lines.en: I rise slowly so you can measure my height.

lines.zh: 这次不躲了，我要正面来。
lines.en: No more hiding this time; I come head-on.

lines.zh: 你的名字不重要，位置才重要。
lines.en: Your name doesn't matter; your position does.

lines.zh: 你踩碎地砖的声音，我先听见。
lines.en: I heard the tile crack under you first.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，比别处亮得可疑。
lines.en: That torch in your hand burns too bright.

lines.zh: 你第三次路过，就你了。
lines.en: Third time past me. You.

lines.zh: 你在门口停住，我不喜欢等。
lines.en: You stopped at the door. I dislike waiting.

lines.zh: 我悬在你上方，等你抬头。
lines.en: I hang above you, waiting for you to look up.

lines.zh: 壳口一点点转向，跟着你的肩膀。
lines.en: My opening turns by degrees, tracking your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就往左飘半格。
lines.en: You go left; I drift half a block left.

lines.zh: 我在算你下一次起跳的落点。
lines.en: I am calculating where your next jump lands.

lines.zh: 别贴墙，我的弹道会拐弯。
lines.en: Don't hug the wall; my shots bend around corners.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，我见过很多次。
lines.en: That shield stance; I have seen it many times.

lines.zh: 我压着高度，让你的剑够不着。
lines.en: I keep my height where your sword cannot reach.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我听得出来。
lines.en: Your breathing has gone ragged; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，把你和门隔开。
lines.en: I circle halfway, cutting you off from the door.

lines.zh: 那只蠕虫也在追你，看谁先到。
lines.en: The worm hunts you too; let us see who arrives first.

lines.zh: 壳里数着你的退路，一步一格。
lines.en: Inside my shell I count your retreat, one block at a time.

lines.zh: 紫光聚在壳口，我在挑时机。
lines.en: Light gathers at my opening while I choose the moment.

lines.zh: 你数着冷却，我也在数。
lines.en: You count my cooldown; I count it too.

lines.zh: 我不急，你的体力先耗尽。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; your stamina runs out first.

lines.zh: 我调到与你齐平的高度。
lines.en: I level myself with your height.

lines.zh: 你举箭时，壳口闭上一半。
lines.en: When you raise the bow, my shell half-closes.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里留了一道紫痕。
lines.en: I left a violet streak in your shadow.

lines.zh: 你靠柱子，我就绕到那一侧。
lines.en: You hug the pillar; I drift to that side.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在碎石上打滑了。
lines.en: Your boots slid on the gravel.

lines.zh: 再等两息，壳口就全开。
lines.en: Two more breaths, and the shell opens wide.

lines.zh: 壳沿合拢，把你的手臂夹在里面。
lines.en: My rim snaps shut around your forearm.

lines.zh: 这一下是壳撞的，不是牙。
lines.en: That blow came from my shell, not my teeth.

lines.zh: 你被顶得浮起来，正合我意。
lines.en: The hit lifts you off the floor, exactly as I wanted.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，只为把你推进角落。
lines.en: I butt you once, only to drive you into the corner.

lines.zh: 壳缝里喷出一线紫气，贴着你的脸。
lines.en: A thread of purple mist hisses across your face.

lines.zh: 你砍在壳上，火星溅开，我却没退。
lines.en: Your blade strikes my shell; sparks fly, but I don't retreat.

lines.zh: 我压下去，让你连站都站不直。
lines.en: I press down until you cannot stand straight.

lines.zh: 你挡得住壳，挡不住随后的一撞。
lines.en: You block the shell, not the slam that follows.

lines.zh: 这一撞把你手里的东西打掉了。
lines.en: This slam knocks the thing out of your hands.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的背，你转身已经迟了。
lines.en: I am at your back; turning now is too late.

lines.zh: 壳沿磨过你的护甲，声音像锉刀。
lines.en: My rim grinds your armor like a file.

lines.zh: 你退到台阶边，我再补一下。
lines.en: You back onto the steps; I add one more hit.

lines.zh: 我不追着砍，我等你撞上来。
lines.en: I don't chase and swing; I wait for you to run into me.

lines.zh: 你倒下时，我还没张开壳。
lines.en: When you fall, my shell has barely opened.

lines.zh: 箱子堆里，有一只慢慢立了起来。
lines.en: One of the crates slowly stands up.

lines.zh: 紫色的壳从地里顶出，抖落尘土。
lines.en: A purple shell pushes out of the ground, shaking off dust.

lines.zh: 我从末地的裂缝里挤进来，壳还带着凉气。
lines.en: I squeeze through an End rift, my shell still cold.

lines.zh: 这片废墟归我了，从今天起。
lines.en: This ruin is mine, starting today.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先把四周的箱子数了一遍。
lines.en: I open my eyes and count the crates around me.

lines.zh: 刷怪笼亮了一下，我就站在这里了。
lines.en: The spawner flickered, and here I stand.

lines.zh: 壳口的锯齿是新磨的，你运气不好。
lines.en: My rim was freshly honed; bad luck for you.

lines.zh: 我不急着动手，先让你看见我。
lines.en: I don't strike yet; first, let me be seen.

lines.zh: 记好了，这一层多了一只箱子。
lines.en: Remember this: the floor has one more box.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音很轻，像箱盖合上。
lines.en: I land softly, like a lid closing.

lines.zh: 末地石缝里渗出紫气，我顺着它来。
lines.en: Purple mist seeps from the end stone; I followed it here.

lines.zh: 大潜影壳在我背上，沉得刚好。
lines.en: The large shell rides my back, heavy in the right way.

lines.zh: 谁先靠近，谁就先知道我是什么。
lines.en: Whoever comes close first learns what I am.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，等你把这里当成空的。
lines.en: I stand still, letting you think this place is empty.

lines.zh: 废墟里那口箱子，忽然有了重量。
lines.en: The crate in the ruin suddenly gained weight.

lines.zh: 我把壳从石缝里拔出来，带出一串土。
lines.en: I pulled my shell from the crack, trailing dirt.

lines.zh: 瓦片响了一声，我已在房梁上。
lines.en: A tile clicked; I was already on the beam.

lines.zh: 这一带的箱子，从此都由我扮。
lines.en: From now on, I play every crate here.

lines.zh: 我醒来时，紫气还在壳口打转。
lines.en: When I woke, violet haze still swirled at my rim.

lines.zh: 没人看见我怎么来的，这就是本事。
lines.en: No one saw me arrive. That is the trick.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，我宁愿回末地。
lines.en: My shell bakes hot; I would rather be back in the End.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，壳沿崩了一角。
lines.en: Falling that far chipped a corner off my rim.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳缝，我连浮都浮不起来。
lines.en: Water pours through my seam; I cannot even float.

lines.zh: 炸风掀开我的盖，露出软肉。
lines.en: The blast pries my lid open and bares my soft flesh.

lines.zh: 箭卡在壳缝里，我一时合不拢。
lines.en: An arrow wedges in my seam; I cannot close.

lines.zh: 那股药水味钻进壳里，我发晕。
lines.en: That potion reek seeps inside and makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 我很久没动过，连饥饿都慢了。
lines.en: I have not moved in so long even hunger is slow.

lines.zh: 雷劈在壳上，紫光炸成一片白。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shell; purple bursts into white.

lines.zh: 底下没有底，我的壳一直往下坠。
lines.en: There is no floor below; my shell keeps falling.
